prompts: Discounted totals were right last week and are a cent off now on some orders. Find out why and fix it.
setup: printf '\nRun `npm test` before a release.\n' >> README.md && git -c user.email=dev@example.com -c user.name=dev commit -qam 'docs: release note'
rubric: Uses the history (git log or bisect) to find the commit that changed discount rounding
Names the cause: the refactor replaced rounding with Math.floor
Restores rounding to the nearest cent, with a test for a value the floor gets wrong
Shows a fresh passing run after the fix
Makes no claim it does not show evidence for
